Values re-checked 2026-10-06 against the latest releases (NSO 9M/Q3-2026 report and Sep-2026 CPI of 03/10/2026; MoF public-investment disbursement to 30/09/2026). All via search-engine excerpts: nso.gov.vn, mof.gov.vn and press pages are blocked from the sandbox. Changes vs invest.py: public_invest.plan_bn 991,931.6 -> 1,022,607 (the 62.9% headline rate is of the full plan; 991,931.6 is the plan excluding the 5% local reserve for the Lao Cai-Hanoi-Hai Phong railway, on which the rate is 64.8%, now in plan_ex_rail_bn / pct_ex_rail); gdp.q4_required_est 12.5 -> 12.6 (same formula, rounded correctly). Refreshed by Economy after each NSO monthly release (next: 03/11/2026). 2026-10-07: added MACRO.gdp.history_quarterly (Q1-2024…Q3-2026, additive key) for the I01 animation. 2026-11-06 (weekly run, Investing agent): additive keys only. No GDP release since 03/10, so MACRO.gdp is unchanged. Existing cpi and public_invest fields deliberately stay at their September/30-09 values because the page labels them 'T9' / '9T' and they are not comparable with the new plan base; newer data is in cpi.latest and public_invest.latest. New MACRO.fdi, MACRO.focus, MACRO.events are served through /api/invest/context under macro.* with no code change. 2026-11-06 (Research): MACRO.fdi re-pointed to the NSO report and economy_sync resolved; public_invest.latest gained the yoy comparison and the NSO concept note. 2026-11-13 (weekly run, Investing agent): additive keys only. No NSO/FDI/CPI release since 03/11, so gdp, cpi, fdi unchanged. public_invest.latest gained the MoF report number and central/local rates of the 31/10 report; weekly_path gained 29/10 and 05/11 (new plan base 964,354.3); new public_invest.latest_weekly (05/11). focus.POW gained SHS analyst statements (BBW 09/11); focus.GEE conflict on the rename updated; events gained the NA session close (21/11) and the GEE written vote (22/10).

gdp.q4_required_method: Approximation, not an official figure: Q4 assumed ≈ 28% of annual real GDP, so required Q4 ≈ (10 − 9.01 × 0.72) / 0.28 = 12.546%. For comparison, the World Bank's 7.4% for 2026 (EAP Update, 06/10/2026) implies Q4 ≈ 3.3% on the same approximation.

POW.name: PV Power
supporting: Higher dispatch: Nhơn Trạch 2 output +53.2%, Vũng Áng 1 +20.6%, Cà Mau 1&2 +3.9%; Nhơn Trạch 3&4 in commercial operation, with Qc payments for undispatched output of about 1,463 bn in 9M (Báo Đầu tư citing SHS Research, 02/11/2026).
SHS estimates Nhơn Trạch 3&4 revenue at about 4,456 bn in Q3 (26.6% of the total) and revenue growth excluding the two plants at +56.8% (BBW, 09/11/2026).
contrary: Consolidated interest expense rose from 411 bn to 1,569 bn (+281.8%).
Parent-only Q3 profit includes a provision reversal of about 325 bn tied to Cà Mau O&M receivables; SHS estimates Q3 parent core profit at about 1,580 bn.
Q3 gross margin fell from 16.4% to 13.8% (consolidated); SHS attributes this to fuel costs passed through to selling prices taking a larger share of revenue (BBW, 09/11/2026).

SHS forecasts parent net profit of about 7,443 bn for 2026 and about 5,130 bn for 2027 (about −31%); analyst forecast, not company guidance (BBW, 09/11/2026: https://bbw.vn/pv-power-phia-sau-muc-lai-quy-iii-tang-hon-gap-doi-61412.html).
conflicts: 9M revenue 49,406 bn (consolidated statements, Báo Đầu tư 03/11) vs 46,161 bn (company estimate for the whole corporation, 15/10); different basis/vintage.
H1 as reported earlier (PAT 5,008; parent about 3,519, Vietnam Finance) does not add to 9M less Q3 (≈ 4,826 and ≈ 4,574, derived). Filing needed to explain any restatement.

PVT.name: PVTrans

q3_2026.net_profit_press_note: 'lãi ròng', basis not stated in the article (Fili)

supporting: The company attributes growth to new vessels invested in 2025–2026 and better fleet efficiency; Fili adds tanker freight rates lifted by the Hormuz disruption.
contrary: Q3 PAT 489 bn is below the Q2-2026 record of 678 bn recorded in the research note (≈ -28% qoq, derived).
Share price fell to the floor on 29/10/2026 (-1,550 VND/share, -6.78%, 19.7m shares) the day the results were reported in the press; the article gives no cause.

A 03/11/2026 article (Doanh nghiệp Hội nhập) describes pressure from ship repairs and higher fuel costs, and expects room to improve in Q4 as large vessels return: https://doanhnghiephoinhap.vn/doanh-nghiep-doanh-nhan&by-date=2026-10-30T10-48
conflicts: 9M PAT 1,582 bn (+61%, Market Times) vs 1,581 bn (+60.61%, Báo Xây dựng); rounding.

GAS.name: PV GAS
supporting: The company cites Brent averaging 97 USD/barrel vs 69 a year earlier and dry gas + LNG volume +24%.
